technical_facts.label: Reviewed Normal / Low Power sample
technical_facts.value: 256 MP4 files: 29 driving and 35 parking per camera. All four cameras measured H.264 at 30 fps. Owner confirms HDR on front and interior, off rear and telephoto.

technical_facts.label: HDR and 2K bitrate
technical_facts.value: All three 2K cameras measured about 14.33 Mbps driving and 4.095 Mbps parking despite different HDR settings. This configuration shows no meaningful bitrate difference; it does not establish that toggling HDR never changes bitrate.

technical_facts.label: Storage evidence boundary
technical_facts.value: Measured values are encoded-video bitrate, not complete-file storage rates. No paired file-size/duration measurements were supplied; file padding, audio and container overhead remain unmeasured.

notes: The older Max-setting submission contained 387 media items; telephoto was Unknown under generic fallback and its parking setting was not supplied. Keep those mixed historical ranges separate from the newer Normal-setting sample.

The newer four-channel Normal / Low Power sample contains 256 MP4 files and eight mode/channel groups. HDR settings are owner-confirmed, not extracted from media. Exact filenames and folder paths remain unverified.
